WITH account_order_counts AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM `order`
    GROUP BY account_id
),
averages AS (
    SELECT AVG(order_count) AS overall_avg
    FROM account_order_counts
),
above_average AS (
    SELECT c.account_id, c.order_count, a.overall_avg
    FROM account_order_counts AS c
    CROSS JOIN averages AS a
    WHERE c.order_count > a.overall_avg
)
SELECT account_id,
       order_count,
       order_count - overall_avg AS above_overall_average,
       order_count - AVG(order_count) OVER () AS above_above_average_accounts_average
FROM above_average
ORDER BY above_above_average_accounts_average DESC
LIMIT 10
